notes.hook: The imagery of a titanium beach ball in a hellscape is immediate and compelling.
notes.clarity: The script moves logically from the environment to the mission and then to the specific science goals.
notes.payoff: The idea of finding ancient oceans in a place that currently melts lead is a great contrast.
notes.visuals: Every frame is high-quality, using a good mix of mission renders and historical context.
notes.loop: The repeat of the 900-degree hellscape line makes the transition back to the start perfect.

rounds.better_than_last: This matches the high quality of the Siberian explosion episode but uses better mission-specific visuals to drive the narrative.
